优先使用所选源，失败后依次尝试备用源。自定义地址必须使用 HTTPS，且不含登录: Use the preferred source first, then try backups on failure. Custom URLs must use HTTPS and contain no credentials, query or fragment. Save to apply to subsequent installations.

Tesseract 按最大任务数并行识别；大图受 400 万输入像素总预算限制，: Tesseract uses up to the selected worker count. Large images share a 4-million-input-pixel budget, reducing simultaneous recognition. Other backends remain serial.
